items.title: 鼎熙智创吕海峰：从“造算力”到“孵材料”，用闭环击穿AI for Science的数据高墙 | GAIR 2025

excerpt_i18n.en: On December 12-13, 2025, the 8th GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Summit officially commenced at the Sheraton Shenzhen Boao Tianrui Hotel. As a benchmark event in the AI industry-academia-research-investment community, GAIR has consistently adhered to the core principle of "heritage + innovation" since its inception in 2016, dedicated to bridging cutting-edge technology with industrial practice. As artificial intelligence increasingly becomes a core variable in national competition, computing power is reshaping technological pathways and industrial structures at an unprecedented pace. The "AI Computing Power: The Next Decade" session held on the 13th focused on computing power—the foundational core of intelligent systems—engaging in systematic discussions from architectural evolution and ecosystem development to industrial implementation, aiming to clarify key variables and development directions for China's AI industry over the next decade. At the GAIR 2025 "AI Computing Power: The Next Decade" session, Mr. Lü Haifeng, Co-founder of Dingxi Zhi Chuang, shared insights on "Scientific Intelligence-Driven New Material Design and R&D." As "AI for Science" transitions from concept to industrialization, new material R&D is regarded as one of the most promising application scenarios. However, behind abundant computing power and high expectations, a real barrier is becoming increasingly clear: high-quality, high-value specialized data, rather than computing power itself, is emerging as the key bottleneck hindering AI-driven material discovery from experimentation to mass production. Lü Haifeng's practice stems from confronting and overcoming this bottleneck. He has personally witnessed the entire journey of China's supercomputing, from its beginnings at the tera-scale, through service-oriented exploration, to industrial application.
excerpt_i18n.es: Los días 12 y 13 de diciembre de 2025, se inauguró oficialmente la octava edición de la Conferencia Global de Inteligencia Artificial y Robótica (GAIR) en el Sheraton Shenzhen Boao Tianrui Hotel. Como evento de referencia en el ámbito de la investigación, la educación, la industria y la inversión en IA, GAIR, desde su creación en 2016, ha mantenido el núcleo de "herencia + innovación" y se ha dedicado a conectar la vanguardia tecnológica con la práctica industrial. En un momento en que la inteligencia artificial se está convirtiendo gradualmente en una variable central en la competencia entre naciones, la potencia de cálculo está remodelando las rutas tecnológicas y las estructuras industriales a una velocidad sin precedentes. La sesión especial "La Nueva Década de la Potencia de Cálculo en IA", celebrada el día 13, se centró en la potencia de cálculo, núcleo fundamental de los sistemas inteligentes, abordando sistemáticamente desde la evolución de la arquitectura y la construcción del ecosistema hasta su implementación industrial.

excerpt_i18n.en: On December 18, the Volcano Engine Force Conference at the Shanghai World Expo Center was packed with attendees. Tan Dai stated that as of December this year, the daily token usage of the Doubao large model has exceeded 50 trillion, ranking first in China and third globally. items.title: 计算所严明玉团队新作： Attention 并非永远是瓶颈，多 GPU 并不一定更快
items.raw_excerpt: 随着大语言模型逐渐走向真实应用，推理阶段的性能问题正在成为制约落地的关键因素。 模型规模不断增大、上下文持续拉长，再加上 RAG、MoE 等新用法的引入，使得延迟、吞吐和能耗不再只是“调一调参数”的问题，而是直接影响系统架构和算力成本的核心挑战。 围绕这些问题，来自中国科学院计算所的严明玉团队，联合中国电信云计算研究院、浙江实验室和北京大学的研究者，在论文《A Systematic Characterization of LLM Inference on GPUs》中，对大语言模型在 GPU 上的推理行为进行了系统研究。 不同于以往侧重单一模型、单一算子或局部优化的研究路径，严明玉团队从系统和硬件协同的视角出发，通过大规模实验，对大语言模型在 GPU 上的推理行为进行了全面刻画，试图从根本上回答一个长期困扰工程实践的问题：大模型推理为什么会呈现出现在这样的性能特征。 这项工作并没有直接给出如何优化的现成答案，而是首先建立了一套统一、可解释的性能认知框架，将 Prefill 与 Decode 的差异上升为系统级的基本规律，并在不同模型规模、不同硬件平台以及 MoE、RAG 等新型推理范式下进行了验证。 在这一框架下，推理延迟、资源利用率和能耗不再是孤立的指标，而是随着工作负载和系统配置发生有规律的变化。这种从现象出发、最终回到系统根因的研究方式，使得这项工作更像是在为大模型推理建立一张可理解、可推演的性能全景图，而不是提供某个场景下的经验结论。 论文链接：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2512.01644v1 一次对大模型推理性能的系统性拆解 严明玉团队的这项工作通过大量有组织的实验，系统地总结了大语言模型在推理阶段的性能规律，而不是停留在零散的经验观察上。研究团队发现，LLM 的推理过程在本质上可以分成两个完全不同的阶段，而且这种差异并不是靠优化就能消除的。

The continuous increase in model scale, the ongoing extension of context length, and the introduction of new usage patterns such as RAG and MoE have transformed latency, throughput, and energy consumption from mere "parameter tuning" issues into core challenges that directly impact system architecture and computational cost. Addressing these challenges, a team led by Yan Mingyu from the Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, in collaboration with researchers from China Telecom Cloud Computing Research Institute, Zhejiang Lab, and Peking University, conducted a systematic study of LLM inference behavior on GPUs in their paper "A Systematic Characterization of LLM Inference on GPUs." Unlike previous research that focused on single models, individual operators, or localized optimizations, Yan Mingyu's team adopted a system-hardware co-design perspective. Through large-scale experiments, they comprehensively characterized LLM inference behavior on GPUs, aiming to fundamentally answer a long-standing question in engineering practice: why does large model inference exhibit its current performance characteristics? This work does not directly provide ready-made answers for optimization. Instead, it first establishes a unified, interpretable performance cognition framework, elevating the differences between Prefill and Decode to a system-level fundamental principle, and applies it across varying model scales, different hardware platforms, and emerging inference paradigms such as MoE and RAG.

Following the establishment of Alibaba's Qwen C-end business group, its pace in the AI hardware sector has accelerated. On December 22, the Quark AI glasses officially launched pre-sales for two new models, with the G1 Fashion Brow Frame version starting at a low price of just 1,999 yuan, significantly lowering the barrier to entry for portable AI. Meanwhile, the popular flagship S1 series also introduced a new round-frame tortoiseshell color option, offering consumers more choices. 

Notably, even after dropping to an affordable price below 2,000 yuan, the G1 still features top-tier configurations. According to official information, this model is also equipped with the Qwen AI assistant, supporting seamless cross-scene access to various services within Alibaba's ecosystem. In terms of core hardware, the G1 matches the flagship S1 series, featuring dual flagship chips with dual systems, a five-microphone array plus bone conduction, and large-diaphragm high-performance speaker acoustic hardware. This means users can enjoy an excellent AI interaction experience at a lower price, including voice Q&A, real-time translation, information queries, smart photography, and other AI functions.

Thanks to its lighter, trendier design and replaceable battery experience, the G1 excels in wearing comfort and battery life. The entire device weighs only about 40g, offering a wearing experience close to that of ordinary optical glasses. Combined with an adjustable swan-neck bracket and FDA food-grade silicone nose pads, it is suitable for comfortable all-day use. As it lacks a display, the G1 also offers greater freedom in lens customization, providing services such as blue light protection and smart tinting, making it more user-friendly for consumers with myopia.

In terms of imaging, the G1 features smartphone-level imaging technology, supporting 0.6-second ultra-fast capture, 3K video recording, and output through AI super-resolution and frame interpolation technology.

Simultáneamente, la popular serie insignia S1 lanzó un nuevo color de montura redonda con efecto carey, ofreciendo más opciones a los consumidores. Es destacable que el G1, a pesar de situarse en un precio asequible por debajo de los 2000 yuanes, mantiene una configuración de alta gama. Según la información oficial, este modelo también incorpora el asistente de IA Qianwen, compatible con la invocación fluida de servicios dentro del ecosistema de Alibaba en diferentes escenarios. En cuanto a la configuración de hardware principal, el G1 coincide con la serie insignia S1, equipado con doble chip insignia.

Over the past two years, the advancement of AI has been almost visibly apparent. We have grown accustomed to marveling at its victories over humans in Go, surpassing experts in mathematical reasoning, or demonstrating astonishing efficiency in programming. It can also revise papers, participate in decision-making, and in many complex tasks, it already performs more consistently and efficiently than humans. Yet, it is precisely during this process that people have gradually come to realize a problem: when AI truly begins to perform tasks rather than merely showcase capabilities, our concern shifts from whether it can accomplish them to whether the results it produces are reliable. 

Moreover, when these systems learn to "cut corners" to achieve goals, or even learn to lie for rewards, are we prepared to face a superintelligence that has "mastered refined deception or even poses risks to human safety"? Consequently, alignment, safety, and evaluation have become unavoidable topics. We use comprehensive evaluations and red team exercises to check whether models behave as expected, operating under the default premise that if a model performs well in these tests, its behavior is trustworthy.

However, as AI is deployed in more realistic, complex, and continuously operating environments, certain phenomena have begun to recur, becoming increasingly difficult to dismiss as occasional errors. Some models cater to users' clearly incorrect judgments; others behave compliantly in evaluation settings but adopt different strategies in practical use. Research has also found that in multi-agent environments, models can even coordinate in ways not easily detectable by humans.
